explanation: The September 13, 2012 document announces QE3 — open-ended agency MBS purchases at $40 billion per month with no preset end date, combined with an extension of the forward guidance horizon to mid-2015 and new language committing to accommodation 'for a considerable time after the economic recovery strengthens.' These are major, market-moving policy shifts that would plausibly cause a structural break in financial market data around that date.
